consciousnessModelR: Educational Simulations for Consciousness Theories

Source: R/consciousnessModelsR-package.R
consciousnessModelR-package.Rd

consciousnessModelR provides simplified computational simulations for teaching and exploring major ideas in consciousness studies.

Details

The package includes toy models inspired by Global Workspace Theory, Integrated Information Theory, attention competition, broadcast dynamics, and threshold-based models of awareness-like processing.

These functions are educational abstractions. They do not measure, detect, or prove consciousness in biological or artificial systems.
